headline: Read a book + make art!
body_html:
Please reach out if you’d like me to facilitate a community-based art workshop with one of my books! With my training and expertise in art therapy, I believe the art process can be a powerful way of applying what is read and talked about in a group setting. My art groups generally include:

  • A storybook reading and intro
  • Discussion around the book or topic
  • One hour of art-making
  • Sharing and debriefing

These community-based workshops are approximately 2 hours in length.

If you’re a faith-based community, I love to base my art projects off of Coloring God’s Love for Me featuring 100 promises in the Bible. These devotions include object lessons that make learning God’s promises more concrete and tangible for readers of all ages. Although written for 6-9 year olds, the book and workshop can be tailored to teen and adult groups. If you schedule with me, I will include an author signing of the book as well as copies for purchasing.

*Disclaimer: These community-based art workshops are not art therapy. If you’re looking for clinical art therapy, please visit the American Art Therapy Association Art Therapist Locator to find a registered art therapist in your area.*
